headline: Cybersecurity and mobile apps.
intro: Strakatá turistika and Plavecká škola Lavia are live. NaučMěTo is still in development.

Strakata-Turistika-ANDROID.title: Strakatá turistika
Strakata-Turistika-ANDROID.summary: A Flutter GPS app and a separate website for the same season.
Strakata-Turistika-ANDROID.intro: Strakatá turistika is a phone app and a website. The Flutter repository ships the GPS app for Android and iOS. The website is a second repository, for trips, GPX files, and the season board.
bullets: Flutter application for Android and iOS, built around GPS.
The website is a second repository: trips, GPX files, scoring, and the public board.
Listed on Google Play, and on LinkedIn as active since January 2025.

plavanilavia.title: Plavecká škola Lavia
plavanilavia.summary: The school site at plavanilaviabrno.cz. Next.js, no database, hosted on Vercel.
plavanilavia.intro: The site for Plavecká škola Lavia. The season lives in the repository, staff edit it in the admin, and a save commits to GitHub so Vercel can rebuild.
bullets: Public site for Plavecká škola Lavia at plavanilaviabrno.cz.
Next.js on Vercel, with season content stored in the repository.
Staff edit that content in the admin page; a save commits to GitHub and Vercel rebuilds.

Nauc-Me-To.title: NaučMěTo
Nauc-Me-To.summary: Still in development. A quiz, a cheat sheet, and flashcards from uploaded study material.
Nauc-Me-To.intro: NaučMěTo is still in development. It takes a PDF, slides, or notes and turns them into a quiz, a cheat sheet, and flashcards. Supabase handles the account, the files, and the database.
bullets: Turns an uploaded PDF, slides, or notes into a quiz, a cheat sheet, and flashcards.
Supabase handles auth, storage, and the database.
